item.title: Pocket TTS in Basque: real-time speech synthesis on a plain CPU
item.description:
TL;DR

I’ve adapted Kyutai’s Pocket TTS model to Basque: Pocket TTS Basque. It runs on an ordinary computer’s CPU, 3.5 times faster than real time, and it can clone voices.

Filling a gap

Interesting options for Basque speech synthesis have appeared in recent months. I wrote earlier about the Piper TTS and OmniVoice models. But they sit at two extremes:

  • Piper TTS: light and fast, it runs on any device. But its quality is limited, and it can’t clone voices.
  • OmniVoice: excellent quality and voice cloning. But it’s much bigger and heavier.

Pocket TTS sits between the two. It has around 100M parameters (much smaller than OmniVoice), runs in real time on a plain CPU, offers higher quality than Piper and can also clone voices: a clean 5-10 second recording is enough.
